title: Polytopic symmetric interior-penalty approximation of elliptic SPDEs driven by spatial white noise
summary: We analyse symmetric interior-penalty discontinuous Galerkin approximations of elliptic stochastic partial differential equations driven by spatial Gaussian white noise on quasi-uniform polytopic meshes. The low regularity of the exact random field precludes the usual SIP consistency argument. We instead restrict the same continuum white-noise functional canonically to the discontinuous polynomial space and separate the error into stochastic forcing-restriction and deterministic discretisation components.
